description: Recovery checkpoints for the RecoveryProgressAgent. Every entry is taken from ONE passage of backend/eval/eval_corpus.json (EV-TKA-REC-*, EV-THA-REC-*, EV-TKA-REHAB-02/03, EV-THA-REHAB-04), except the two retained TKA-03 day-7 ROM entries from rag/data/seed_knowledge.json. Where the passage gives no number the expected state is stored in words only -- no number is ever invented. `quote` is a short verbatim fragment of the passage the entry rests on.

entries.quote: By Post-Op Day 7, patients should aim for 70°-90° of passive flexion

entries.quote: near-full extension (0°-5°)
